rationale: DeepSpeedTrainer used WarmupLR (warmup-then-flat) instead of WarmupDecayLR (warmup-then-decay), so post-warmup lr plateaus rather than decaying. Detection observes lr over consecutive steps after warmup and asserts monotonic decrease toward warmup_min_lr (monotonic, not implementation_equivalence: no reference run needed since flat-vs-decreasing is directly visible from the lr trace). Layer is schema_topo_precond — single rank but precond guards 'step > warmup_steps' and the assertion only valid in the decay phase. P1 reads lr (Tier 3 control variable). category=lr_schedule per table A mapping of scheduler bugs.
